events.verdict: Turner (MIL) attempts to slip away from his screening position and the contact with Coulibaly (WAS) during the pick is marginal.
Bagley III (WAS) applies his hands to Bagley III (WAS) and releases away as the defenders switch.
Bagley III (WAS) legally contests Antetokounmpo's (MIL) shot attempt.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) and George (WAS) come together at the same spot and the contact at the end of the drive is marginal.
Turner (MIL) contests George's (WAS) shot attempt, and the contact after the release is marginal.

Rollins' (MIL) right arm grazes the back of Bagley III's (WAS) head as his right hand makes contact with the ball.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Rollins (MIL) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Wizards.
Green (MIL) steps forward into Middleton's (WAS) space and initiates body contact that affects his shot attempt.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) does not bring part of his hand under the ball when he brings his dribble to a pause.
Green (MIL) establishes himself in Coulibaly's (WAS) path prior to the contact.
Antetokounmpo's (MIL) right leg extends outwards during his fadeaway shot attempt and the lower body contact with Middleton (WAS) is marginal.
Middleton (WAS) contests Antetokounmpo's (MIL) shot attempt and the contact as Antetokounmpo's right leg extends outwards during his release is marginal.
Middleton (WAS) trips over Antetokounmpo (MIL) as he turns to run down the court.
Rollins (MIL) brings his left hand towards the ball and the contact with McCollum's (WAS) arm is marginal.
Green (MIL) legally contests Middleton's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
Coulibaly (WAS) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Bucks.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) establishes himself in George's (WAS) path prior to the contact.
George (WAS) moves alongside Rollins' (MIL) path and dislodges the ball with his left hand as he defends the shot attempt.
Coulibaly (WAS) initiates contact with Antetokounmpo's (MIL) arm that affects his shot attempt.

McCollum's (WAS) off-arm comes out away from his body as he turns towards the baseline and he grazes Rollins' (MIL) head during the drive. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Middleton (WAS) grasps and then quickly releases Rollins' (MIL) jersey off-ball.
Rollins (MIL) dislodges the ball from Middleton (WAS).
Rollins (MIL) legally contests McCollum's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
Coulibaly (WAS) deflects the ball away from Antetokounmpo (MIL).
Antetokounmpo (MIL) initiates contact with Coulibaly's (WAS) body as he defends the shot attempt.
Coulibaly (WAS) legally contests Green's (MIL) jump shot attempt.
